info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Auto Insurance Quotes Discounts-v2-spec
info.description: The Auto Insurance Quotes Discounts API provides access to various discounts associated with auto insurance quotes. It allows consumers to view eligible discounts that can be applied to their insurance quotes, facilitating informed decision-making and cost savings. Typically utilized by insurance providers and comparison platforms, this API enhances user experiences by listing available discounts and related criteria. By leveraging this API, developers can integrate discount information seamlessly into their applications, promoting efficient insurance quote comparisons.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch a list of available discounts that can be applied to quotes. Use this to enhance your quoting process and offer better pricing options to your customers.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve discount information for quotes. It must contain the appropriate parameters to specify which discounts to fetch based on the current context of the request.

ListAutoInsuranceQuotesDiscountsRequest.description: A request body schema for retrieving quotes with discounts. This string should contain the necessary information in a JSON format to query the discounts for quotes.
